heraldic.concept: Royal Heraldic: flat armorial tinctures (gules, azure, or, purpure, tenne) laid edge-to-edge like a roll of arms; clean pale parchment, crisp sepia ink.

illuminated.concept: Illuminated Manuscript: ground mineral pigments on vellum -- cinnabar/vermilion, lapis ultramarine, gold ochre, folium purple, minium -- with gilt hairlines tracing every inked frontier and coast.

campaign.concept: Campaign Chronicle: deep earth-weight grand-strategy colours -- oxblood, slate royal blue, antique gold, plum, sienna -- on darker worn parchment with heavy umber frontiers.
